Maya - Events Ops: Heads-up: finalizing the registration + captioning plan for next week's global webinar. Need decisions on multi-language captions and vendor drops.
Carlos - Growth: We should offer localized registration pages (EN/FR/DE). Routing each language into its own HubSpot list for regional followup.
Nina - Content: Agree. If we have transcripts in multiple languages, we can produce localized clips. Vendor can do transcription + translation? What's the SLA/cost?
Maya - Events Ops: Vendor confirmed: human QA for ENG + machine translate for FR/DE with editor pass. SLA: 72h for localized transcripts + 48h for social clips. Cost estimate posted in notes.
Omar - Legal: For translations, we need a clause on accuracy and a quick TOS blurb: "Translated materials are provided for convenience; original English transcript is authoritative." Also ensure privacy consent copy covers third-party processors.
Maya - Events Ops: Proposed Zoom recording profile (applies to webinar template):
```
Cloud recording: ON (active speaker + gallery)
Auto-transcribe: ON (English)
Allow manual transcript upload: ON
Record separate audio files: ON
Enable cloud recording retention: 30 days for raw, 1 year for edited assets
Allow live transcript download: OFF (until we confirm translations)
```
ZoomBot: Webinar created: "Redwood: Inference Cost Benchmarks" 2026-04-15 09:00 PDT. Cloud recording enabled.
Carlos - Growth: HubSpot plan: create lists: webinar_2026_04_15_en, webinar_2026_04_15_fr, webinar_2026_04_15_de. Form IDs will be shared after page build. UTM set: utm_campaign=inference_bench_apr26, utm_source=webinar.
Nina - Content: Asset plan: 1 long-form trimmed recording, 3 regional highlight edits (EN/FR/DE), and 5 social cutdowns. Need timestamps and raw markers from Maya.
Maya - Events Ops: I'll annotate the recording timeline (speaker changes + demo sections) and post markers to this thread. Also enabling panelist local recording to capture clean audio if vendor needs it.
VendorBot: Vendor confirmed S3 pickup: s3://vendor-uploads/redwood/webinars/2026-04-15/. They will pull raw + SRT.
Omar - Legal: One more: For EU registrants we must surface data transfer note if translation vendor is US-based. Add conditional text on the FR/DE pages.
Carlos - Growth: Follow-up cadence suggestion: immediate thank-you + replay (48h), then regional case studies at 3 days, sales CTA at 7 days for attendees >4 minutes. Routing rule: attended>4min -> assign SDR.
Nina - Content: For caption burning vs sidecar: prefer sidecar VTT for social snippets, burn captions for long-form regional videos. Vendor to provide both VTT and burned versions?
Maya - Events Ops: Vendor will supply SRT/VTT and burned MP4s for each language. Upload path: s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-04-15/localized/{lang}/.
Carlos - Growth: Will the registration page include timezone auto-detect and an alternate session CTA? We might need to add a second session for APAC.
Maya - Events Ops: Good call. Let's add an alternate replay-only session scheduled for APAC-friendly hours. Zoom allows registration to the second session as a separate webinar. I'll schedule it if registration numbers justify it.
Omar - Legal: Consent checkbox language approved with tweak: "I consent to event-related communications and third-party processing as described in the Privacy Policy." Add link + country field.
Nina - Content: A/B test email subject lines: A) "Replay + Key Findings from Redwood's Cost Benchmarks" B) "How we cut inference cost by X% — replay". Liaise with Growth on subject performance.
Carlos - Growth: I'll run the subject A/B with 20% split. HubSpot form will be: webinar_2026_04_15_en (form id pending). Routing rules and UTM tags will be set at publish.
Maya - Events Ops: Preflight checklist for tomorrow's dry run:
- Verify webinar template applied
- Confirm vendor S3 access and IAM role
- Run 15m recording test with translation pipeline
- Confirm panelist local recordings enabled
- Confirm page shows conditional EU transfer note
Maya - Events Ops: Running dry run at 2pm PT. Will post results.
ZoomBot: Dry run completed. Test recording + transcript captured. Translation pipeline latency ~28s for machine translate, vendor QA queued.
VendorBot: Sample SRTs uploaded: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-marketing/events/2026-04-15/localized/en/sample.srt
Nina - Content: Got sample SRT. Starting localization plan. Will request burned captions for long-form and VTT for socials.
Carlos - Growth: Once form IDs are in, I'll wire up regional nurture flows and SDR assignments. Also will tag campaign in ad console for attribution.
Omar - Legal: Final reminder: do not display attendee names publicly without consent. Keep participant list internal.
Maya - Events Ops: Final: raw recording + panelist local files will be available at s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-04-15/raw/. I'll post access links after the event.
Nina - Content: Thanks all. Will post timeline for edits after recording (expect localized rough cuts in 72h). :sparkles:
